sources.author: Aidan
patch_list: Blocks banner, interstitial, and rewarded video ads, prevents the AppLovin MAX, Google Mobile Ads, Amazon, Facebook Audience Network, Vungle, BidMachine, and Mintegral advertising runtimes from initializing, and hides the in-app Remove Ads…
Disables Google Play Games sign-in, cloud-sync prompts, achievements, review requests, and Play Store update and cross-promo launches.
Disables Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics collection and neutralizes Flow Free's event, user-property, and crash-reporting bridges.
Makes the hint balance display 999 and allows hints to be used without consuming hints or watching rewarded videos.
Unlocks every level pack and every level, including premium and individually purchased packs, without changing saved progress or purchase state.
Unlocks every premium theme and the Complete Package theme bundle in the store without changing saved progress or purchase state.
